images.alt_en: Mara Venn and the seven delegations face failing life support in the council ring while Illuminara listens beneath the approaching debris.
images.alt_sl: Mara Venn in predstavniki sedmih vrst se v svetu postaje soočajo z odpovedujočim življenjskim okoljem; Illuminara posluša pod bližajočimi se razbitinami.

images.alt_en: Illuminara redraws the atmosphere route as seven reversible loops while Daro holds his independent latch and Eres checks the return paths.
images.alt_sl: Illuminara preoblikuje pot ozračij v sedem povratnih zank; Daro drži neodvisni zapah, Eres pa preverja povratne poti.

images.alt_en: A human child paints seven colors, a small Vey holds the cup, and a Rekk technician lowers a console as Illuminara watches.
images.alt_sl: Človeški otrok riše sedem barv, mali Vey drži lonček, tehnik Rekk pa spušča konzolo; Illuminara jih opazuje.
